messages:
Alex (AE): Heads-up — NimbusHealth POC failing intermittent auth errors during bulk evals. Seeing 401s and occasional 504s during nightly runs.
Sam (Solutions): On it. Can you paste an example log and confirm which flow is failing (embeddings vs rerank)?
Alex (AE): POC details: doc-class + PHI redaction -> embeddings -> semantic search. Nightly eval ~10k docs. First seen 2026-03-18 22:12 UTC. Truncated log below:
```
2026-03-18T22:15:02Z ERROR 401 unauthorized token expired
2026-03-18T22:15:10Z WARN token refresh failed: 502 upstream
2026-03-18T22:16:01Z ERROR 504 gateway timeout
```
Kevin (SE): Looks like token refresh race + occasional upstream timeout. Are you using short-lived rotated tokens or a static service key for the eval runner?
Alex (AE): Short-lived tokens rotated every 90m via their infra. Nimbus explicitly requires rotation policy and BYO-KMS for prod.
Priya (Security): Nimbus requirement: HSM-backed keys + rotation audits. We only support BYO-KMS on Private or Dedicated with HSM integration. Hosted cannot provide BYO-HSM. This affects scope.
Maria (AE): Pricing note — Private adds setup + platform fee. If Nimbus wants to proceed faster, can we propose Hosted with contractual logging controls as an interim? They'll need legal sign-off.
Sam (Solutions): Short-term workaround suggestion: spin up a Dedicated staging pool in their preferred region, pin a service token for the eval runner, enable request-level audit logs, and route eval traffic through a dedicated model variant. No HSM but improves stability.
Kevin (SE): Practical config changes to try immediately:
- increase client retry to 5 with exponential backoff
- disable continuous batching for the eval job (reduces long-lived KV pressure)
- pin model version `open-embed-XL-v2` and limit concurrency to 4
Curl snippet to validate auth flow:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["patient note text..."]}'
```
Alex (AE): I'll test pinned token + retries. Nimbus wants stable runs for acceptance by 2026-03-30. How realistic if we do the Dedicated workaround now?
Sam (Solutions): Realistic. Dedicated removes noisy neighbor issues and reduces transient 502/504s significantly. Tradeoff: higher per-token cost and changes to SOW.
Priya (Security): For acceptance we need an itemized checklist we can sign off on. Proposal:
- End-to-end runs of 10k docs with zero auth errors (or <0.1% transient failures documented)
- Audit logs exported and retained for 30 days
- KMS integration plan (HSM) scheduled for GA — or BYO-KMS on Private/Dedicated
- Median embedding latency < 300ms for single-doc calls
- Data residency proof and contractual addendum
Alex (AE): Adding success criteria to the POC doc. Client also added eval success thresholds: redaction F1 >= 0.92 and semantic recall@10 >= 0.85. Will include prompt set and seed versions.
Maria (AE): Commercial note — Dedicated staging for two weeks will cost ~$6k (placeholder) and Private + HSM is materially higher and 2–3 week setup. Need Nimbus legal to approve interim exception for hosted if they insist on faster timeline.
Kevin (SE): Also note: turning off continuous batching decreases efficiency but reduces partial failures on very large async jobs. Recommend sample runs at small scale before full 10k run.
Alex (AE): Ran a quick job with pinned token + retries, got ~1/200 failures (still intermittent). Attaching logs to the POC ticket.
Sam (Solutions): If 1/200 still fails, escalate to eng-runtime. Tag them and include the failing request IDs.
deploy-bot: Deployed branch `auth-retry-fix` to staging at 2026-03-19T02:10Z
Sam (Solutions): If eng-runtime patch lands, we can roll the fix to the Dedicated pool and re-run the full eval. If not, we need a temporary manual token-rotation shim.
Priya (Security): I'll draft an interim security attestation today: pinned token control, network ACLs, audit log export paths — to present to Nimbus while KMS work is scheduled.
Alex (AE): Thanks. I'll update Nimbus: recommend Dedicated for POC stability, Private (with BYO-KMS/HSM) for GA. I'll attach acceptance checklist, updated SOW, and the eval script with prompt versioning. Will follow up once eng-runtime responds.
Kevin (SE): Please ensure the SOW captures eval seed & prompt set versions and the rollback/fallback policy if we hit performance regressions.
Alex (AE): Will do. Closing the loop for now — will reopen if 401s reappear after the staging deploy.
